newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil growth of 2.8 pct good - Mendonca de Barros.
newsitem.headline: Brazil growth of 2.8 pct good - Mendonca de Barros.

text.p: Gross domestic product growth in 1996 of 2.8 percent would be good for Brazil, said Jose Roberto Mendonca de Barros, economic policy secretary at the Finance Ministry, in an interview published Friday.

Mendonca de Barros told the Gazeta Mercantil financial daily that GDP growth next year is likely to be subject to "agitation" but that large swings from stagnation to rapid expansion were not expected to recur.
"Growth this year could reach 3.0 percent, if it were 2.8 percent that would be a good number," the paper quoted him as saying.
